curatedMovie.curiosityHook: When high-profile targets start falling in exact sequence, Harry and Quan face an urgent puzzle: who authored the fatal list, and whose name is next?
curatedMovie.description: Dirty Harry Callahan teams up with partner Al Quan to investigate targeted murders across the city, only to discover the prominent victims are part of a macabre betting pool predicting who will die next.
curatedMovie.vibeSummary: Fast-paced, suspenseful action thriller with moderate grit, ideal for an engaged solo crime-watch night.
curatedMovie.whyWatch: Directed by Buddy Van Horn, this fast-moving 91-minute action thriller delivers lean, suspenseful franchise crime storytelling driven by escalating danger and ticking-clock stakes.
